_comment: Template. Copy to settings.local.json and fill in apiKey + model IDs. settings.local.json is gitignored; never put a real key in this file.

extraction._comment: maxTokens must cover REASONING as well as output if the model is a reasoner. A budget that only fits the answer produces empty content with no error.
extraction._providerIgnore: Optional. Upstream providers to exclude. requireParameters only filters providers that do not SUPPORT a parameter; a provider can support the schema, return schema-valid JSON, and still pick the wrong delta branch. That is measurable only by running --eval --providers <name> and comparing. Excluding keeps every other provider, so this is much weaker than pinning.
extraction._timeoutSeconds: Optional per-role deadline, falling back to provider.timeoutSeconds. Worth setting low for extraction: it returns a small amount of JSON and normally answers in seconds, so a long wait only delays the retry that was going to fix it. Timeouts are retried automatically.

story._comment: historyTurns: how many past turns of prose the narrator is reminded of. A turn is TWO messages (player input + narration), so cost is roughly 200-300 tokens per turn against the narration role. Canon holds the long-term truth; this holds the texture canon cannot - what an NPC just said, the thread of a conversation. 0 disables it.
